prompt: reply.send decides whether a custom Content-Type is JSON, and whether it already declares a charset, with case-sensitive substring searches on the raw header string. As a result: 'application/json; CHARSET=utf-8' gets a second '; charset=utf-8' appended; 'ApPlIcAtIoN/JsOn; ChArSeT=utf-8' is not recognised as JSON, so sending an object fails with a 500; and 'application/json; x-charset-hint=a' (a parameter whose name only contains 'charset') gets no charset at all. Fix reply.send so it parses the Content-Type header with Fastify's ContentType parser (lib/content-type.js): JSON is detected from the parsed media type, case-insensitively (any media type containing 'json', such as application/vnd.api+json), and a charset is considered declared only when there is a parameter named charset, compared case-insensitively. When a JSON media type has no charset parameter, '; charset=utf-8' is appended to the header. Expected results when sending { hello: 'world' }: 'application/json; CHARSET=utf-8' and 'ApPlIcAtIoN/JsOn; ChArSeT=utf-8' are sent unchanged with status 200 and the JSON body; 'application/json; version="2"' becomes 'application/json; version="2"; charset=utf-8'; 'application/vnd.api+json' becomes 'application/vnd.api+json; charset=utf-8'; 'application/json;' becomes 'application/json; charset=utf-8'; for 'application/json; x-charset-hint=a' the header keeps the x-charset-hint parameter and ends with '; charset=utf-8'.
requirement: reply.send parses the content-type header with ContentType; JSON handling applies when the parsed mediaType contains 'json' (media types are lowercased by the parser); a charset counts as declared only if a parameter named charset exists (names compared case-insensitively). Otherwise '; charset=utf-8' is appended to the normalised header. Parameter names merely containing 'charset' do not count.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 'application/json; CHARSET=utf-8' is sent unchanged (no second charset)
'ApPlIcAtIoN/JsOn; ChArSeT=utf-8' is treated as JSON: status 200, JSON body, header unchanged

'application/json; version="2"' becomes 'application/json; version="2"; charset=utf-8'; 'application/vnd.api+json' gets '; charset=utf-8'; 'application/json;' becomes 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
'application/json; x-charset-hint=a' keeps the x-charset-hint parameter and ends with '; charset=utf-8'

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit.

provenance.notes: Real defect in fastify v5.9.0 (case-sensitive substring JSON/charset detection in reply.send), fixed upstream in 6f63ce93 (#6830), which spans 5 files (a shared ContentType cache). Behaviour probed on base and reference before writing. The hidden suite grades reply.send behaviour only, not the internal cache API; it does not require a specific re-serialisation of parameter quoting.
